description: The Tell (Legendary perk) in House of Pips: Rival's playable bones glow while remaining face-down.
html:
Perks › Legendary

The Tell

Legendary perk · Information

Rival's playable bones glow while remaining face-down.

In-game card text

How it works

Rival's bones that could be played on the board right now glow, while staying face-down. You learn how many of Rival's bones fit the table, though not which numbers they show.

  • The glow updates as the board changes. Extra copies change nothing.

At a glance

RarityLegendary
TypeInformation
How to get itComplete its three career trials (Play 150 bones; Win 10 hands; Visit the boneyard 30 times), then unlock it for 1,500 Bone Bucks.
